reviewed.reason: Initializes backend context and mounts loose LinkerLoad backend above cooked stores in editor, below default otherwise, when loose-file loading is enabled.
Inserts store backends in descending priority and optionally forms hybrid cooked editor backend blending Zen and LinkerLoad.
Queries ordered backends until a status other than None or Missing is returned; lower priority can satisfy higher backend misses.
First redirect reported by ordered backend list wins; no redirect if all return false.

evidence_limitations: Static method classification, not implementation parity certification
IoStore backend mount arbitration across sources still requires differential tests
